description: CSUTLDTC, the called date-validation subprogram, invoked as the @Service it became. LS-DATE='2022-07-19' and LS-DATE-FORMAT='YYYY      ' are this case's two LINKAGE SECTION parameters (L84-L85); LS-RESULT PIC X(80) (L86) is the output and is asserted below as the single WS_MESSAGE_80 line. This program opens no file and is reached by no JCL, so it seeds no dataset, writes no record and takes no job parameter - its entire observable behaviour is the 80 bytes L97 moves into LS-RESULT and the severity L98 moves into RETURN-CODE. Expected values are STATICALLY DERIVED from the 01 WS-MESSAGE declaration at L42-L57 and the group move at L122, never captured from a COBOL run, which is impossible here. Arm 2 by a second route: a mask that parses cleanly but carries only the year. This separates 2507 from 2518 - the picture string here is well formed, which is precisely why it is 'insufficient' rather than 'bad' - and it drives the guard that requires either a year with a month and a day, or a year with a day of the year.
